title: Operation snapshot
description: Durable record of an accepted command's progress. Operation status is separate from the status of the job, task or workspace the operation acts on: a `succeeded` cancel operation means cancellation was carried out, not that anything succeeded. `operation` names the command (such as `jobs.cancel`) and discriminates `result`; service schemas narrow `result` per operation.

operation.description: The control operation, as the subject names it without the target ID, such as `jobs.submit` or `workspaces.execute`.

status.description: pending: recorded, not started. running: in progress. succeeded / failed / cancelled: terminal.
